title: The Fountain Model  chipmunk walk modes + water as computation

walk_modes.concept: Berry walks the graph. but HOW it walks determines WHAT it finds. 4 modes, each a different leg from graph-walkers.json.

smart_walk.behavior: follow links with highest relevance. use heuristic: 'how close is this page to what the user wants?' the curiosity function guides.
smart_walk.when: user is looking for something specific. Berry knows the target. shortest RELEVANT path.
smart_walk.water_analog: river in a channel. the banks guide the flow. water takes the path gravity + banks define.

dumb_walk.behavior: pick a random outbound link. follow it. repeat. no goal. no heuristic. just wandering.
dumb_walk.when: exploration. serendipity. 'show me something I didn't know I wanted.' diffusion.
dumb_walk.gait: stumbling, drunk. every step is a coin flip. covers ground eventually.
dumb_walk.water_analog: spilled water on a flat surface. spreads in all directions. no channel. pure diffusion.

new_path.behavior: go DEEP. follow links. but NEVER visit a page already visited. prioritize pages with lowest visit count in analytics.
new_path.when: filling gaps. finding orphans. the Klein eye audit. 'what have we NEVER seen?'
new_path.gait: burrowing. root-like. pushes into dark corners. the mole, not the bird.
new_path.water_analog: groundwater. seeps through cracks. finds the path of least resistance underground. you can't see it but it's moving.

scenic_view.behavior: visit the most-linked, most-visited, most-connected pages. the highlights. the tourist route.
scenic_view.when: showing off. new visitor orientation. 'here's the best of the membrane.'
scenic_view.gait: leisurely. stop-and-look. the tour guide. lingers at viewpoints.
scenic_view.water_analog: waterfall. the scenic route IS the cascade. water falls dramatically where the landscape creates a cliff. the cliff is the content that drops your jaw.

the_fountain.concept: the site IS a fountain. data naturally flows DOWN (gravity = entropy, decay, forgetting). we push it UP (computation = energy, organization, publishing). the fountain is the cycle.

water_flows_down.what: without energy, data settles. pages go stale. feeds stop updating. links break. the puddle evaporates.
water_flows_down.physics: gravity. entropy. the second law. things fall apart. the center cannot hold.
water_flows_down.prediction: water flowing DOWN is predictable. you know where it goes: to the lowest point. traditional computation IS this: deterministic, gravitational, follows rules.
water_flows_down.in_the_HUD: analytics decay. traffic drops. papers stop being cited. crates stop being downloaded. the reflecting pool dries up.

we_push_it_up.what: every session is energy pumped into the fountain. every commit pushes data UP. every deploy lifts content against gravity.
we_push_it_up.physics: the pump. the motor. human energy + chipmunk labor. convection current from the core (Kevin) through the mantle (chipmunk) to the surface (HUD).
we_push_it_up.computation: the UP push is computation. sorting, classifying, publishing, connecting. against entropy. the fountain sprays water INTO the air  against gravity  and for a moment, the water is higher than where it started.
we_push_it_up.in_the_HUD: new papers, new crates, new pages, new feeds. the buckler at the top of the fountain  the credibility shield  is where the water sprays outward and catches the light.

the_cycle.up: commit ? push ? deploy ? live on membrane ? visited ? cited ? downloaded
the_cycle.peak: the buckler. the DOIs. the investigation. the highest point of the spray. maximum visibility. maximum impact.
the_cycle.down: time passes ? traffic decays ? links break ? feeds stale ? data settles
the_cycle.basin: the reflecting pool. the puddle. the null state. grey. waiting for the next pump cycle.
the_cycle.repeat: the fountain never stops while the pump runs. the pump IS the human + chipmunk. turn off the pump ? the fountain becomes a puddle ? the puddle evaporates ? null.

water_as_computation.thesis: water is the original computer. it solves differential equations by existing. every river is an analog computation of 'shortest path downhill.' every watershed is a map of gravitational potential. every fountain is a computation of 'energy vs gravity.'

properties.deterministic_flow: water flows downhill. always. you can predict where it goes. this IS classical computation  deterministic, repeatable, gravitational.
properties.path_finding: a river finds the fastest path to the sea. it doesn't compute Dijkstra  it IS Dijkstra. the water molecules explore all paths simultaneously and the fastest path gets the most flow.
properties.erosion: water erodes the path it takes. the more it flows, the deeper the channel. the deeper the channel, the more water flows through it. POSITIVE FEEDBACK. this IS machine learning  reinforcement of successful paths.
properties.evaporation: water evaporates from the top (surface). the most exposed data evaporates first (most visible = most attacked by entropy). the deep water stays (core content persists).
properties.freezing: water freezes into crystal (ice). data crystallizes into DOIs, papers, published crates. frozen water doesn't flow  it PERSISTS. the diamond lattice IS frozen water.

the_eco_system.eco: oikos (Greek) = house, home, habitat. ecology = study of the home.
the_eco_system.the_watershed: all the data that flows into OUR basin. primals.eco is a watershed  every feed, every paper, every visitor flows into our reflecting pool.
the_eco_system.the_water_table: the baseline. how much data is always present, even when no one is pumping. the crates.io downloads that happen even when we're asleep. the RSS subscribers who poll automatically. the VESICLES that might be health-checking us.
the_eco_system.the_aquifer: deep storage. the papers. the DOIs. the investigation data. doesn't evaporate. doesn't flow away. the permanent water supply.

modern_digital_world.traditional_computation: water flowing down. deterministic. input ? output. classical. the river. the waterfall. PREDICTABLE.
modern_digital_world.machine_learning: erosion. the path reinforces itself. the river digs its own channel. the model trains on its own output. EMERGENT.
modern_digital_world.quantum_computation: evaporation + condensation. the water is in ALL states simultaneously (vapor). measurement collapses it to one state (rain drop). SUPERPOSITION.
modern_digital_world.the_fountain: all three. traditional (water falls down = gravity = rules). ML (channel deepens = reinforcement = learning). quantum (spray = superposition = all paths until observation). the fountain IS the unified model.

data_needed.graph: the adjacency list from klein-eye-topology audit (56 nodes, ~200 edges)
data_needed.visit_counts: from CF analytics (page view counts by path)
data_needed.link_weights: default 1.0, adjusted by: mutual cycle = 2.0, hub link = 1.5, dead end = 0.5

output.path: ordered list of pages Berry visits
output.narration: Berry describes each stop (from KNOWN map)
output.visualization: path drawn on desk-globe.js as a trail
